text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by the Latvian State Radio on Wednesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The third world congress of Latvian physicians started in Riga today with some 3,000 participants.
- The cabinet decided to work on regulations to make the border guard force professional by the end of the year. It is currently comprised of conscripts.
- Latvia's Way, one of the three biggest political parties, tops an opinion poll with 12 percent support and the Peasants' Union follows with 10 percent.
- Latvia and Lithuania will tomorrow in Vilnius continue sea-border delimitation talks.
